geometry_exploration_mm.note: Part of each articulated leg may lie inside the shell. Internal clearances, joint axes, foot placement and recovery reach are unverified.

architectures.name: 12관절 비교안
architectures.role: Lower actuator count comparator; foot orientation is coupled to leg posture. Bipedal capability is not presumed.

architectures.name: 14관절 우선 검토안
architectures.role: Adds fore-aft rear-foot orientation control. Lateral ankle control, axis arrangement, flat contact and bipedal balance remain unverified. Not a committed motor count.

mass_allowance_kg.status: engineering allocations, not CAD or measured masses; locomotion motors excluded

screening.model_scope: Quasi-static contribution from a vertical support force at a chosen joint: (m*g/support_count)*horizontal_moment_arm. Equal load sharing, no inertia, no lateral force or limb weight. Not joint-by-joint inverse dynamics, continuous rating or motor selection. Tip speed examples use one rigid rotating link, not robot walking speed.

verification_gates: Both stances: actual joint axes, ranges and motor envelopes fit without interference; face remains forward with head-pitch motion.
Single-support biped stance: feasible foot contact, center of pressure, joint torques and velocity; include head mass and sensed tether force.
Quadruped to biped transition and side/back self-righting: feet/forepaws can reach ground and produce useful moments before shell collision.
One actuator and then one leg: loaded response, current-to-torque calibration, holding temperature, transmission compliance, backlash and current limits.
Free-body walking and recovery simulation with identified actuator limits; later hardware transfer. A pose illustration or tether-assisted stand is not a pass.

rear_leg_packaging.status: one-hind-leg kinematic proxy; not a released mechanical design
rear_leg_packaging.upright_frame: x forward, y left, z up; mount rotates +90 degrees about y for the quadruped reference pose
limitations: Only cylindrical motor envelopes and a rectangular foot are checked; visual link capsules are excluded. Screws, brackets, cables, housing cut-outs and other limbs are not modeled.
A fixed mount and prescribed poses are used. No simulation timesteps, controller or whole-body balance validation.
The joint-sway axis changes world orientation as the body pitches; this is a candidate axis arrangement, not a conventional quadruped hip assertion.
Vertical-force Jacobian calculations omit leg weight, inertia, horizontal force and contact-feasibility constraints.
This joint-mounted integrated-actuator layout is a comparison baseline. Remote knee/ankle transmission is not designed.
